caption: Put any item in each of the six item frames; a frame turns through 8 positions, one right-click each. Set the code by turning the three code frames on the right side, then turn the three dials on the left side to match them: the output turns on (open) only when every dial shows the same position as its code frame, and never for a moment while you turn. Wire a piston door or an iron door to the output: a dust line from the output cell. Inside, each dial's comparator and its code frame's comparator (one level down) feed two subtracting comparators that catch a difference either way; a repeater carries any difference to the output torch, which turns off (opens and closes within 8 ticks).
